statement: Production or execution of poor or ineffective code
description: This risk arises when an agent generates or executes code that is incorrect, inefficient, insecure, or unsuitable for the intended task. As a result, the code may fail to achieve desired outcomes, introduce bugs or vulnerabilities, or cause operational disruptions when deployed or run.

controls.statement: Run agent-generated code only in isolated compute environments with network access blocked by default
Use static code analysers to detect security vulnerabilities and code quality issues
Use code linters to screen generated code for bad practices and poor syntax
Review all agent-generated code before execution
Monitor runtime and memory consumption of agent-generated code
